title: Code and data for: Scenario optimization with Markovian data: a posteriori risk certificates from a single trajectory
description: Code and simulation data that reproduce every computed figure, table and number of the paper 'Scenario optimization with Markovian data: a posteriori risk certificates from a single trajectory' by Jiachen Shen and Hui Zhong: the certificate of the paper and the compression certificates for independent data, the lower-bound threshold on sticky chains, the exact exceedance probabilities of the adversarial chains, and the Monte Carlo study of the reserve problem with its archived runs. A comparison script checks every printed value.
